limitations: Target scale, location and required purity were not provided, so catalog prices do not establish a reaction budget.
Supplier pages are snapshots and do not guarantee China-region stock, import eligibility or delivery time.
Not every component has a current SDS in this snapshot; the report is not an EHS approval.
The cited primary studies are small-scale or high-throughput studies and do not establish scale-up safety.
External mechanistic papers provide general DFT interpretation context and do not validate candidate-specific descriptor-yield causality.
